```python
from collections import Counter

words = (
    "randolph wand hardhat coates shortcake pent paddy inferring peril "
    "woodstock withdraw lepidopterist aryl tropopause disputant vermiculite"
).split()

def check_letters(claims, index):
    return all(
        word in words
        and len(word) > index
        and word[index] == letter
        and ord(letter) - ord("a") + 1 == rank
        for word, letter, rank in claims
    )

def check_groups(groups, expected_words):
    flattened = [word for group in groups for word in group]
    if Counter(flattened) != Counter(expected_words):
        return False
    # Every stated ordering must hold, even when a group is unresolved.
    return all(
        left < right
        for i, group in enumerate(groups)
        for later_group in groups[i + 1:]
        for left in group
        for right in later_group
    )

prefix = [[w] for w in
          ["aryl", "coates", "disputant", "hardhat", "inferring",
           "lepidopterist"]]
suffix = [[w] for w in
          ["randolph", "shortcake", "tropopause", "vermiculite"]]
w_group = [["wand", "woodstock", "withdraw"]]

first_letter_claims = [
    ("randolph", "r", 18), ("wand", "w", 23),
    ("hardhat", "h", 8), ("coates", "c", 3),
    ("shortcake", "s", 19), ("pent", "p", 16),
    ("paddy", "p", 16), ("inferring", "i", 9),
    ("peril", "p", 16), ("woodstock", "w", 23),
    ("withdraw", "w", 23), ("lepidopterist", "l", 12),
    ("aryl", "a", 1), ("tropopause", "t", 20),
    ("disputant", "d", 4), ("vermiculite", "v", 22),
]

final_order = (
    "aryl coates disputant hardhat inferring lepidopterist paddy pent "
    "peril randolph shortcake tropopause vermiculite wand withdraw woodstock"
).split()

checks = [
    Counter(w for w, _, _ in first_letter_claims) == Counter(words)
    and check_letters(first_letter_claims, 0),

    check_groups(
        prefix + [["pent", "paddy", "peril"]] + suffix + w_group, words
    ),

    check_letters(
        [("pent", "e", 5), ("paddy", "a", 1), ("peril", "e", 5)], 1
    ),

    check_groups([["paddy"], ["pent", "peril"]],
                 ["pent", "paddy", "peril"])
    and check_groups(
        prefix + [["paddy"], ["pent", "peril"]] + suffix + w_group, words
    ),

    check_letters([("pent", "n", 14), ("peril", "r", 18)], 2),

    check_groups([["pent"], ["peril"]], ["pent", "peril"])
    and check_groups(
        prefix + [["paddy"], ["pent"], ["peril"]] + suffix + w_group, words
    ),

    check_letters(
        [("wand", "a", 1), ("woodstock", "o", 15), ("withdraw", "i", 9)], 1
    ),

    check_groups([["wand"], ["withdraw"], ["woodstock"]],
                 ["wand", "woodstock", "withdraw"])
    and check_groups([[w] for w in final_order], words),

    final_order == sorted(words),
]

for number, valid in enumerate(checks, 1):
    print("Thought {}: {}".format(number, "valid" if valid else "mistake"))

first_error = next((i for i, valid in enumerate(checks, 1) if not valid), None)
expected = "No" if first_error is None else str(first_error)
submitted = "No"

print("Computed alphabetical order:", " ".join(sorted(words)))
print("Expected answer:", expected)
print("Submitted answer:", submitted)
print("CHECK PASS" if submitted == expected else "CHECK FAIL")
```
